summary: Iteration 6 (Weekly Goals) frontend E2E tested end-to-end. All requested behaviors verified: GoalsWidget renders between hero and controls, empty state, dialog form, metric select (7 options), auto-direction on metric change (Weight→down, FFMI→up), add/edit/delete goals with sonner toasts, persistence via fitmepro:goals:v1, Header 'New Goal' action, status coloring for on-track/ahead/behind/off using seeded 2-week-old goals, no horizontal scroll at 1280/768/375 widths, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: GoalsWidget.jsx uses .toFixed(2) for change/current values; for BMI/WHtR small deltas may lose precision (0.001 step). Consider using meta.step-derived precision.
sign() helper in GoalsWidget shares name with parameter 'sign' inside fmt(); safe today but shadowing is confusing.
computeGoalProgress returns actualChange as absolute delta; status 'off' triggers when ratio<0 (moving opposite direction). Verified working for all four buckets via seeded data.
seed_data_creation: Seeded fitmepro:measurements:v1 (age 30 male 175/72/waist82/hip96/neck38/wrist17) and 4 weight goals with startDate T-14d to exercise status buckets (on-track, ahead, behind, off).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Goal testids: goals-widget, goal-add-btn, goal-dialog, goal-metric, goal-dir-down, goal-dir-up, goal-amount, goal-target, goal-note, goal-submit, goal-card-{id}. Header: action-new-goal. Storage key: fitmepro:goals:v1. Status ratio buckets: <0 off, <0.8 behind, 0.8-1.2 on-track, >1.2 ahead. Seed goal shape: {id, createdAt, startDate, metric, direction, amountPerWeek, startValue, targetValue?, note?}.
